title: Scrum Master
jobDescription: Job Description: As a Scrum Master at Evolent, you will act as a servant leader, coach, and change agent, enabling agile teams to deliver measurable business outcomes in the healthcare domain. Beyond facilitating ceremonies, you will drive team effectiveness, flow optimization, and outcome-based delivery, while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer value focus. Agile Facilitation & Delivery Excellence Facilitate Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Reviews, Retrospectives) with a strong focus on outcomes, flow, and business value rather than just process adherence. Ensure alignment of team deliverables with product goals, OKRs, and customer impact. Coaching & Team Enablement Coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile mindset, product thinking, and value-driven delivery. Enable teams to become self-organizing, cross-functional, and high-performing. Drive adoption of modern Agile practices (e.g., flow metrics, limiting WIP, reducing cycle time). Flow & Delivery Optimization Identify and remove impediments proactively, including systemic and cross-team dependencies. Improve predictability, throughput, and cycle time using data-driven insights. Reduce spillovers, rework, and change failure rates through continuous improvement. Metrics & Data-Driven Insights Track and analyze flow metrics (Cycle Time, Lead Time, Throughput, Predictability, Change Failure Rate). Move teams from output metrics (velocity) to outcome metrics (value delivered, customer impact, OKRs). Use tools like Jira, dashboards, and Power BI to provide actionable insights to leadership. Stakeholder Collaboration Partner closely with Product Owners on backlog refinement, prioritization, and clarity of requirements. Facilitate alignment across engineering, product, operations, and business teams. Support PI/Quarterly planning, dependency management, and risk mitigation. Continuous Improvement & Transformation Foster a culture of inspection, adaptation, and psychological safety. Drive Agile maturity and transformation initiatives at team and org levels. Actively contribute to Agile community of practice and knowledge sharing. AI & Innovation Enablement (New Market Expectation) Encourage teams to leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, automation) for productivity and quality improvements. Identify opportunities to improve engineering efficiency and delivery using emerging technologies. Key Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Business, or related field. 3–6+ years of Scrum Master / Agile Coach experience, preferably in healthcare or regulated environments. Strong understanding of: Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe – working knowledge) Product mindset & outcome-driven delivery Flow metrics and lean principles Certifications: CSM / PSM (required); SAFe or advanced Agile certifications preferred. Core Competencies Coaching & facilitation excellence (not just meeting management) Strong data literacy (metrics interpretation, dashboards) Ability to handle conflict resolution, influencing, and stakeholder management Experience working with distributed/global teams Tools & Technology Jira (advanced usage), Confluence Power BI / Excel for reporting & analytics Exposure to AI-enabled tools and automation platforms (good to have) Domain Knowledge Healthcare / payer / claims / compliance knowledge is a strong advantage What Success Looks Like (Outcome-Oriented Expectations) Improved team predictability and flow efficiency Reduction in spillovers, cycle time, and rework Strong alignment between team output and business outcomes High team engagement, ownership, and collaboration Measurable contribution to product and customer value delivery Why Join Us: Opportunity to drive Agile transformation in a high-impact healthcare environment Work on data-driven and outcome-focused delivery models Exposure to cutting-edge AI and modern engineering practices Strong culture of learning, collaboration, and leadership growth To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. Mandatory Requirements: Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business. Evolent Health is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. jobDescription:

Manage the Saa S life cycle: discover Saa S usage, manage Saa S configuration policies, optimize Saa S entitlements, automate Saa S-related employee onboarding and offboarding processes, measure and publish reports on Saa S usage and costs for IT leadership Collaborate with digital workplace engineering & security teams to establish and document Saa S configuration, security controls, compliance requirements and processes to continually identify vulnerabilities in configuration and noncompliant usage of Saa S apps Research, prototype, and implement emerging AI capabilities and advanced scripting solutions to continuously improve Saa S operations, user experience, and enterprise automation maturity Administer and optimize Atlassian platforms (Jira, JSM, Confluence, Assets/CMDB, Statuspage, Atlassian Analytics) by embedding AI driven capabilities. Utilize scripting and APIs to extend platform functionality, support complex migrations, and integrate third-party AI tools. Integrate Saa S and enterprise platforms to enable and streamline IT processes (e.g., ITSM, IAM, ITAM) and business workflows, facilitating tool adoption by understanding stakeholder requirements, managing implementations, and conducting testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Engage with vendors’ support teams to resolve platform issues Create and communicate knowledgebase articles to support IT staff and minimize support overhead Ensure that the needs of all customers are met accurately and in a timely fashion, as documented in team Service Level Agreements (SLAs) Continuing to improve technical expertise through research and identification of new processes and technical alternatives to resolve problems and/or implement continuous improvement Adhere to and advocate all requirements of IT Privacy and Security Policies and Procedures Actively contribute to team initiatives by sharing expertise in AI, automation, and scripting. Mentor team members on modern automation practices, foster a culture of innovation, and drive adoption of intelligent solutions across the organization Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field 3+ years of experience in IT operations, Saa S administration, and supporting cloud-based Atlassian applications (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence) Proven 1-2 experience leveraging artificial intelligence and advanced scripting (e.g., Python, Power Shell, REST APIs) Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and documentation skills Familiarity with ITSM, IAM, CMDB systems Experience working with audit, privacy, and security requirements, including SOC2, and HIPAA Ability to work in a dynamic environment, including the ability to manage and prioritize tasks while maintaining a service-oriented work ethic Must be very detail-oriented, organized and able to work independently to support multiple complex projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Ability to learn new technologies and explain technical issues to diverse audiences is preferred Relevant certifications, such as ITIL® Foundation Certification and Atlassian cloud certifications, are preferred To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. title: Associate Manager/Manager, FP&A
jobDescription:
Job Description Evolent Health is looking for a Finance Manager to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team: This position is an FP&A Manager role with the ability to work across all of Evolent Health’s business lines and operations Evolent’s FP&A team supports all company stakeholders, including the executive leadership team and the Board of Directors, with data-driven financial and operational analyses to inform strategic decision-making, business planning, and areas of future investment The FP&A team works cross-functionally with all departments across the organization, including Accounting, Growth, Technology and Operations

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategic Finance / Business Partnering / Special Projects Contribute to development of financial models / materials as part of special projects, including finance and business development initiatives (e.g., new investments, new business Op Ex) Support new or upsell opportunities through contributions of financial inputs and review of new product models. Maintain existing standard models (e.g., pricing, cost allocations, staffing) to drive consistency, accuracy, and scalability across our business Produce summary financial materials including monthly and quarterly financial summaries and any ad hoc materials (e.g., analyses for Executive stakeholders) as needed Summarize key business metrics and KPIs to track drivers of financial health. Analyze, present and provide recommendations on variances in KPIs to Executive stakeholders. Business Planning / Financial Reporting Support the Strategic Finance team by executing key deliverables below with excellent attention to detail Produce financial packages / reports with business intelligence / KPIs Maintain Adaptive Insights financial information, including automating reporting and developing process automation initiatives Continuously seek to improve our financial models as the business evolves and the customer base and product offerings expand Contribute to the annual budgeting process and corporate planning Department budget owner resourcing (supporting business line leaders with monthly reports, job requisitions support, department P&L forecasting) Finance Operations Cost center management / coordination between Talent, Workday, and Finance Build and maintain project plans to organize around the rollout of new initiatives Create, automate, and maintain financial reporting tools based on business needs Workday & Adaptive configuration and maintenance Putting processes around Finance responsibilities and maintaining processes (e.g., source of truth for new business implementations, tracking changes between Salesforce and new implementations, etc) The Experience We Prefer: Chartered Accountant/CPA or MBA or Master’s degree in Business Finance Manager: 4-6 years of finance experience in corporate finance (FP&A), investment banking, or other Finance role with substantial financial modeling experience and ideally coming from an institution with a training / rotational / development program Big 4 experience preferred Customer service focused with excellent analytical skills, interpersonal skills and executive presence required. Extraordinarily detail oriented and focus on accuracy Extensive experience using Microsoft Excel Ability to balance multiple projects and adapt to new issues/assignments as business needs change. Exceptionally strong analytical abilities, with a track record of identifying insights from financial information and translating into business analytics and recommendations Candidate who thrives with growth-driven changes Experience with Adaptive Insights or other reporting tools like Power BI / Tableau Experience in or exposure to the healthcare space, pricing, and / or operational analytics #LI remote To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. Mandatory Requirements: Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business. Evolent Health is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. title: Platform Engineer
jobDescription: Job Summary As a Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in both software development and Dev Ops practices, managing and enhancing our extensive application suite and cloud infrastructure. You will help drive our transformation in cloud infrastructure management and application reliability by developing internal platform solutions and supporting robust engineering operations. This position is ideal for candidates passionate about both software engineering and Dev Ops and is eager to collaborate within a high-performing team. Essential Functions Design, build, and maintain internal platform services and tooling, including Evolent’s Internal Developer Platform built on Spotify’s Backstage. Develop backend services, APIs, and platform plugins using Python, Go, or Type Script. Enable container-based application delivery using Docker, Kubernetes, with a focus on AKS and Azure Container Apps. Create features that automate infrastructure and operational workflows using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible). Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support consistent, secure, and reliable deployments. Support and guide application teams through containerization and modern deployment patterns. Debug and resolve complex issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers when required. Required Qualifications Strong background as a software engineer, building backend services, internal tools, or platforms. Proficiency in at least one modern language (Python, Go, or Type Script preferred). Experience designing APIs and systems. Solid understanding of software design principles, testing strategies, and code quality standards. Experience with Terraform and Ansible. Working knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with Git-based CI/CD tools (Git Hub Actions, Azure Pipelines, etc.). Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with CNCF projects such as Argo CD, Kyverno and KEDA. Education & Certifications No specific education or certifications required for this role.
